acceptanceCriteria.text: Building and Research show a borderless fast-forward icon immediately after progress percent; Healing shows it after active timer, with no default form.
Icon opens a form above its parent dialog; cancel or Escape closes only the speedup layer, and every spend still requires explicit confirmation.
Selecting a speedup option automatically suggests the agreed just-short-of-completion quantity, capped by owned stock; invalid/zero choices never spend.
Formula, actual component and real Chrome UI/confirmation regressions, full tests, typecheck/build and docs validation pass.

checkpointPayload.description: Replace default expanded speedup forms with borderless fast-forward icons beside Building/Research progress percentage and Healing timers. Open a stacked dialog only on click, keep mandatory confirmation, and suggest quantities from remaining time and owned stock. Clarify minus-one interpretation while implementing independent UI work. Reuse @doc/api/speedup-rpc-contract-and-confirmed-use.

Adapt component/Chrome tests for default-hidden form, trigger placement, stacked cancellation/Escape, auto count and existing spend lifecycle. 4. Run checks, build patch release and update canonical guidance/task/decision impact.
